prompts.light:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production Civica Atlas homepage feature artwork for the Governance Evidence card, exact 3:2 horizontal landscape
Primary request: Create a beautiful, bespoke editorial engraving that communicates comparing several independent governance sources without combining them into one score.
Scene/backdrop: an elegant archival research table seen at a shallow three-quarter angle, with five distinct unlabelled source folios arranged separately beside a brass measuring compass, a restrained balance scale, and a partially unrolled world map; the instruments should feel scholarly and civic, not financial or judicial.
Subject: source-native evidence, careful comparison, provenance, and multiple independent observations.
Style/medium: premium nineteenth-century copperplate editorial engraving on warm ivory paper, fine coherent cross-hatching, confident linework, restrained texture, subtle vignette at the outer edges, consistent with a scholarly reference atlas.
Composition/framing: exact 3:2 landscape; fill the entire frame with a wide connected composition designed for a rounded rectangular web card; strong visual interest across left, center, and right; main objects large enough to read at about 380 by 220 CSS pixels; safe central crop; no tiny isolated square object and no large empty margins.
Lighting/mood: clear soft daylight, calm, meticulous, trustworthy.
Color palette: near-monochrome graphite, muted warm parchment, restrained terracotta and deep navy accents, low saturation.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, charts, rankings, grades, country flags, government seals, logos, watermarks, identifiable people, identifiable modern buildings, sacred imagery, documentary event depiction, fantasy structures, decorative border, or dominant orange wash. This is AI-assisted non-documentary editorial art, not source evidence.
Avoid: generic lone globe, cute icon treatment, clip art, photorealism, 3D render, glossy UI illustration, centered square composition, excessive empty paper.
prompts.dark:
Use case: lighting-weather
Asset type: production Civica Atlas dark-theme homepage Governance Evidence card artwork paired with the supplied light engraving
Primary request: Re-render this exact archival research-table scene as a restrained night engraving for a dark interface.
Composition/framing: preserve the exact 3:2 landscape crop, every folio, map, balance scale, compass, telescope, table edge, and their precise positions and proportions.
Lighting/mood: calm low-key night, scholarly and meticulous, with enough tonal separation to recognize all instruments and separate folios at about 380 by 220 CSS pixels.
Color palette: near-black graphite and deep navy ground with muted warm sepia, restrained terracotta, and soft gold linework; warm accents only, no dominant orange wash and no blue neon cast.
Constraints: change lighting, paper/ink polarity, and palette only. Do not add, remove, move, duplicate, relabel, or reinterpret any object or depicted scene. No text, letters, numbers, charts, rankings, grades, country flags, seals, logos, watermarks, identifiable people, modern buildings, decorative border, or glossy effects. Keep it an AI-assisted non-documentary copperplate editorial engraving.
